Team,

Finance ran the weekly commit export and flagged several opportunities where amount, product/SKU mapping, next step, or probability are missing or inconsistent. We need clean data for Friday's commit review (11/19). Please own the rows assigned to you in the attached export and complete the short checklist by EOD Thursday so the finance team can lock the commit.

Checklist (follow in order):
1) Validate Amount: ensure amount matches latest PO or forecast note; correct currency if needed.
2) Product/SKU: pick the correct SKU from the mapping table in the checklist file (forecast-cleanup-checklist.xlsx).
3) Next Step: select one of: Demo Scheduled / Contract Sent / Legal Review / Awaiting PO.
4) Probability: update to reflect current read (use 10/30/60/90 framework).
5) Owner note: add a 1-line justification in the opportunity comments.

Attachments: forecast-cleanup-checklist.xlsx, oppty-export-20261114.csv (rows assigned).
HubSpot: I’ve highlighted high-commit opps in the hub link below — please update both HubSpot and Salesforce if relevant.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

If you need to reassign any rows, reply with the deal ids and new owner. I’ll run a verification pass Thursday evening and send a final list to Finance.

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
